selectionRule: Select every empirical corpus case present at the exact baseline commit before any second annotation is recorded. This addendum fixes the double-annotation sample without using later agreement, validator, or reconciliation outcomes.

withholdBeforeSubmission: computed corpus metrics and agreement results
provideBeforeSubmission: source inventory and source access locations
the fixed material field paths and requiredForProfile flags
the corpus merit, privacy, and unknown-evidence boundaries

rationale: All three empirical cases already present at the baseline are selected. This avoids choosing cases after observing second-annotation agreement and supplies three independently reviewed cases, which is sufficient to maintain the predeclared 0.25 minimum through the study-plan maximum of twelve total cases if all three second annotations are completed.
limitations: This addendum was created after primary annotations already existed, so it is not part of the original pre-study declaration and must not be described as such.
The selection is deterministic over the baseline corpus but is not randomized and does not make the corpus statistically representative.
Public source material may itself reveal historical outcomes; the independence goal is independent encoding from sources, not blindness to facts contained in those sources.
An annotator's independent=true declaration is an attestation. Repository tooling can check separation of identifiers and field sets, but it cannot prove the human annotation process was independent.
nonClaims: Selection under this addendum does not establish annotation correctness.
Independent agreement does not establish source truth, fairness, merit, or institutional legitimacy.
Completion of these three second annotations does not by itself make the retrospective study complete.
